title: Prove the BIT COPY floor for closed snapshot paths
body:
## Summary

- Prove that replacing one of the actual BIT word's nine rank-seven centre COPYs by independent snapshots of the same unchanged total cannot lower the total paid query rank, even with closed private frame walks: `sum_i(r_i + m_i/2) >= 7`. The same bound excludes a saving in its recursive rank moment.
- Bind the proof to the literal R438 word with all 660 arbitrary persistent input columns and exact rank-eight/projected-rank-seven support witnesses for all nine centres. Include scoped earlier-cut screens and fully charged caller-repair comparisons as supporting evidence.
- Add one self-contained package, [research/bit-copy-path](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ddfc3133cbdf548e163c867d5671f8f01dd5d5ae/research/bit-copy-path/README.md). **No new supplier, κ improvement or selected-frontier change is claimed.**

## Scope and limits

The main written theorem uses rational/real frames, independent copies of one unchanged total, closed nested private MOVEs, exact guarded ERASE, and monotone public propagation after the original COPY phase. Mixed totals, changed factories, additional public query events and general shared routed corrections remain open. The 254-cut finite screen restricts replacement COPY rank to at most four. The coded-caller repair bounds retain their stated decoder/order restrictions.

These are written scoped proofs and exact finite checks with independent **agent** review, not human or formal-kernel certification. Complete supplier admission and the full multiplication theorem remain open. [Proof](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ddfc3133cbdf548e163c867d5671f8f01dd5d5ae/research/bit-copy-path/construction/PROOF.md), [review](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ddfc3133cbdf548e163c867d5671f8f01dd5d5ae/research/bit-copy-path/independent/REVIEW.md), [budgets](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ddfc3133cbdf548e163c867d5671f8f01dd5d5ae/research/bit-copy-path/bounds/PROOF.md), and [concrete next questions](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ddfc3133cbdf548e163c867d5671f8f01dd5d5ae/research/bit-copy-path/README.md#open-next-questions).

## Test plan

- [x] `python3.12 -I -B research/bit-copy-path/verify.py --output /tmp/bit-copy-path-check.json` — ten checks in normal and optimized modes, in both the original checkout and final Git-free scientific export: 40 passing invocations with identical mathematical receipts. Use a fresh output path.
- [x] Independent reconstruction and meaningful omission, inverse, code-edge, budget and disabled-guard controls; arbitrary helpers and exact private cleanup are covered as specified in the review.
- [x] Publication review corrected two overbroad summary phrases. All mathematical code, proof files, inputs and fixed receipts remain byte-identical to scientific commit `d82a679985888b703f689833c2b12780a8243382`; those replays are retained evidence, not newly repeated executions. Final source inventory, original task-card pin, relative links and `git diff --check` pass at `ddfc3133cbdf548e163c867d5671f8f01dd5d5ae`. [Validation details](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ddfc3133cbdf548e163c867d5671f8f01dd5d5ae/research/bit-copy-path/VALIDATION.md).
- [x] [Automatic repository checks](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39432785916) passed onboarding helper tests and package planning at the submitted head. The package-replay job was skipped; this is not hosted execution of the standalone mathematical verifier above. Selected cold replay and predecessor full suites were not rerun; no selected files changed.

## Sources and credit

Canonical [finding and follow-up](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4199); base `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`, priority revision 7. Task `coverage-law-change` has an explicitly documented changed scope: actual BIT query paths. The fresh overlap scan covered 314 open PRs, 3540 closed/merged PRs and 2713 discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings; the nearest dependency heads were rechecked. This is not a novelty certificate.

Credit Ali Romman and Sagar Thakrar's R438 lineage, DreamingOfClouds/eumemic's retained supplier, and Ross Richardson's PR3645 source-code word. The direct-decoder floor 63 is prior work of Russell Seligmann (PR757) and Cody Harris (PR761), following Joel Pulikkan/GamingPuzzled (PR620). [Related work and exact source manifests](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ddfc3133cbdf548e163c867d5671f8f01dd5d5ae/research/bit-copy-path/RELATED-WORK.md) distinguish PR4033/4039/4051/4054 and Thakrar's different fixed-invoice PR3948. Apache-2.0; substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate construction and review agents.
